README.md.basis: Owned fixture boundary statement was authored in this repository and read in full.
README.md.mechanism_summary: Declares the fixture as OXYCOK-authored rehearsal material and forbids treating it as NordVPN reverse-engineering evidence.

session.py.basis: Owned Python session model was authored here; static structure and failure paths were read for contract seeding.
session.py.mechanism_summary: In-memory VPN session transitions require profile identity, reject invalid connect/disconnect ordering, and track an explicit kill-switch boolean without performing network I/O.

capabilities.objective: Authorized target identity and ownership gate

invariants: only listed authorized targets may proceed
hard_negatives: Proprietary NordVPN install paths are not authorized by name similarity
Owned-fixture pass does not authorize product reverse engineering

design.original_design: Explicit rights JSON gate before mission start; path and optional hash pins; proprietary name markers only block unauthorized targets.
design.alternatives: Embed gate inside runtime.start for all domains; rejected for this increment to keep commerce/python missions unchanged.
design.reuse_boundary: Gate is OXYCOK-authored; REA is method reference only.

capabilities.objective: Static inspection of owned VPN session surface

invariants: no Python import or execution of target
hard_negatives: Observation is not NordVPN product evidence
Real REA CLI success is not claimed by the Python provider path

design.original_design: Reuse existing bounded Python AST provider against the owned Nord VPN domain fixture.
design.alternatives: Wait for supported-host REA JS provider; deferred because current fixture is Python.
design.reuse_boundary: Mission runtime reused; fixture and domain gate are new.

capabilities.objective: Abstract Nord VPN domain behavior contracts for original construction

invariants: constructor receives no target source bytes
hard_negatives: Brief text is not a NordVPN clone specification
Public VPN product vocabulary is not mechanism proof
side_effects: Content-addressed brief retained in mission store

design.original_design: Domain-parameterized brief carrying Nord VPN destination label and owned-fixture evidence metadata only.
design.alternatives: Hand-authored product requirements document without mission linkage; deferred to keep custody connected.
design.reuse_boundary: No NordVPN source expression may cross into construction.

hard_negatives: In-memory kill_switch is not a host network kill switch
No packet routing or firewall mutation is performed

design.original_design: Small explicit state machine for rehearsal and future original VPN-session workers.
design.alternatives: OS-level kill switch; excluded until separately authorized and qualified.
design.reuse_boundary: Fixture behavior is not NordVPN kill-switch equivalence.

capabilities.objective: Evidence custody, unknowns and hard negatives for proprietary exclusion

invariants: proprietary exclusion cannot be rewritten to pass
hard_negatives: Absent NordVPN product pin is not treated as empty success
side_effects: Append-only mission events when rehearsal runs

design.original_design: Combine existing mission FAILURE_PRESERVED behavior with domain rights forbidden list.
design.alternatives: Silent skip of unauthorized targets; rejected.

capabilities.objective: Original planner construction from abstract brief only

hard_negatives: Planner is not a VPN client
Planner pass is not NordVPN reconstruction
side_effects: Files created only under mission construction output path

design.original_design: Reuse existing abstract-brief constructor with domain=nordvpn facts.
design.alternatives: Hand-written VPN client; out of scope for this seed.
design.reuse_boundary: Constructor remains project-authored template, not REA or NordVPN code.

lessons.failure: Starting Nord VPN work by pointing REA at proprietary product paths without an ownership pin.
lessons.positive_method: Pin REA as method reference, authorize an owned rehearsal surface, and keep proprietary NordVPN inspection blocked until rights and census exist.
lessons.hard_negative: A successful owned-fixture mission is not NordVPN reverse engineering, legal clearance or product equivalence.
lessons.inheritance: Future Nord VPN domain workers must call the admission gate and retain blocked proprietary attempts.

unknowns: No authorized NordVPN product source pin exists yet.
Real REA 6.7.0 remains ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED on this host.
Public VPN product behavior claims are not mechanism-validated here.
Original VPN-client implementation and independent qualification remain open.
